Tailwind CSS 3 Cookie - Cookiz

Cookiz is a TailwindCSS v3 is utility-first CSS framework packed with classes like flex, pt-4, text-center and rotate-90 that can be composed to build any design, directly in your markup. It's fast, flexible, and reliable — with zero-runtime.
